title: dichanthium saccharoides subvar. laguroides
intro: Dichanthium saccharoides subvar. laguroides, commonly known as Buffalo Grass, is a type of perennial grass native to the Great Plains region of North America. The health benefits of Buffalo Grass include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Buffalo Grass may also include saponins, terpenoids, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
